item.title: Trajan Decius, 249-251 AD. AR, Antoninianus. 5.00 g. 21.37 mm. Rome.
item.description: Trajan Decius, 249-251 AD. AR, Antoninianus. 5.00 g. 21.37 mm. Rome. Obv: IMP C M Q TRAIANVS DECIVS AVG. Bust of Trajan Decius, radiate, draped, cuirassed, right. Rev: DACIA. Dacia, draped in long robe reaching feet, standing left, holding vertical staff with head of ass in right hand. Ref: RIC 12b; Cohen 16. Very Fine.

item.title: Trajan Decius, AD 249-251. AR, Antoninianus. 3.70 g. 23.23 mm. Rome.
item.description: Trajan Decius, AD 249-251. AR, Antoninianus. 3.70 g. 23.23 mm. Rome. Obv: IMP C M Q TRAIANVS DECIVS AVG. Radiate and cuirassed bust of Trajan Decius, right. Rev: DACIA. Dacia standing front, head to left, holding staff, surmounted by a dragon’s head, in her right hand. Ref: RIC 12b; Cohen 16. Very Fine.

item.title: KAISERZEIT, Traianus Decius 249-251, Antoninian 249-251, Rom.
item.description:
KAISERZEIT, Traianus Decius 249-251, Antoninian 249-251, Rom.

Av.: IMP C M Q TRAIANVS DECIVS AVG, drapierte Büste mit Strahlenkrone nach rechts. Rv.: D-A-CIA, Dacia steht mit Eselskopfstandarte nach links. 4,54 g. RIC: 12b. Sehr schön-vorzüglich
